description: A real Monitor job gated by the Stop journey: its ten-second natural lifetime starts only once the queue is staged. Unlike park-wait, this is not used to measure parked timer accumulation.

steps.text: I'll start the build in the background.

input.command: gate="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/journey-park-stop"; while [ ! -f "$gate/release" ]; do [ -d "$gate" ] || exit 1; sleep 0.05; done; date +%s%3N > "$gate/started.tmp"; mv "$gate/started.tmp" "$gate/started"; sleep 10 && echo 'build ok'

steps.text: The build is running in the background now. I'll wait for it.
